description: EventCallbacks of tools\e2e\data\event-callbacks.json that no browser test proves, each with the reason; checked by tools\e2e\tests\event-coverage.spec.js (every callback must be proven or listed here, never both, and every entry must still name an existing callback). A known defect is flagged "knownDefect": true (and its reason starts with KNOWN DEFECT); each flagged entry needs an expected-failure case in KNOWN_DEFECT_CASES (tests\helpers\event-cases.js) that references the key and starts passing, failing the suite, once the defect is fixed, and the spec reports the number of known defects.

exemptions.reason: Not reachable by design of the element: wa-select (type-to-select) and wa-date-input (segment editing) cancel every printable keydown, so the browser dispatches no keypress. The OnKeyPress binding shared through WaInputBase is proven on the other controls.
wa-rating dispatches no input event, so the inherited OnInput is deliberately left unbound (parity-config.json unboundEventCallbacks for wa-rating); there is nothing to dispatch.

wa-video loads its Src through a <source> child of its inner video; a failed source fires error on that source element, which wa-video does not relay, and only a media decode error of the video element itself reaches OnError, which cannot be produced deterministically. The relay path is the same as for the proven play/pause/ended events.
